programme.desc: Former schoolfriends Ian and Dan have drifted apart - and don't know how to talk about their feelings and the struggles of adult life. Can Bear help.

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: A firefighter is on hand to try to save a Somerset terrace.

programme.title: Clive Myrie's African Adventure
programme.desc: Clive learns about his family story on an emotional visit to a former slave fort, before getting a big celebratory welcome - and a new name - from the elders of the Fante people.

programme.title: Clive Myrie's African Adventure
programme.desc: Clive experiences the beauty of Nigerian art in one of the continent's largest cities.

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: Twenty-four hours a day, the latest national and international stories as they break.

programme.title: Political Thinking with Nick Robinson: Omid Djalili
programme.desc: Nick Robinson in conversation with people who influence our political thinking.

programme.title: Impossible
programme.desc: Game show in which players score points by answering questions correctly while avoiding the Impossible answers.

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Jason Manford hosts the quiz where it's not just about finding the right answer, it's finding the best answer that counts.

programme.title: The Boss
programme.desc: Susan Calman hosts the quiz show of tactics, knowledge and nerve. Contestants must work as a team, but ultimately there can only be one Boss.

programme.title: The Vintage French Farmhouse
programme.desc: Three antiques dealers head to a famous market in L'Isle-sur-la-Sorgue, the Venice of Provence, where they compete to find two hidden treasures each to sell online for the most profit.

programme.title: Villages by the Sea - Botallack
programme.desc: Archaeologist Ben Robinson discovers how the small hamlet of Botallack was the centre of the Cornish tin and copper mining industry, and supplied a deadly poison to the world.

programme.title: Oceans: Indian Ocean
programme.desc: In the first of two episodes in the rich tropical waters of the Indian Ocean, the team explores its remote and pristine underwater worlds and go in search of the elusive dugong.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Christina Trevanion and Raj Bisram are on hand to find a selection of objects to take to auction. Christina values a pair of Wedgwood plates, while a gold guinea impresses Raj.

programme.title: Richard Osman's House of Games
programme.desc: The celebrities face their final quizzes, and the week's winner is crowned.

programme.title: Do You Know Your Place?
programme.desc: Paul Gorton takes charge of the unreliable tour as Vernon Kay challenges Anneka Rice, comedian Shane Todd and Radio 1Xtra DJ Remi Burgz on the sights and stories of Coleraine.

programme.title: The Wild Gardener
programme.desc: Wildlife cameraman Colin Stafford-Johnson returns home to Ireland on a personal quest to transform his old childhood garden into a haven for native plants and animals.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty looks back at some of the remarkable gardeners shining a light on how people can grow their own nutritious food fresh from the garden.

programme.title: Big Cats 24/7
programme.desc: The Big Cats 24/7 team returns to the Okavango Delta. With bigger cubs to feed, the lions hunt around the clock. New female leopard Lediba has cubs, and cheetah Pobe is back.

programme.title: Live at the Apollo
programme.desc: The magnificent Kae Kurd introduces comedians Laura Smyth and Liam Farrelly to the stage. Contains some strong language and adult humour.

programme.title: Newsnight, followed by Weather
programme.desc: Insights and global interviews on the crucial news stories of the day. With Matt Chorley. Followed by Weather.

programme.desc: Happily living alone, 12-year-old Georgie confronts reality when her dad suddenly appears.
